subject: Shiny server working, but not with app requiring very large initial data load from DB

messages.author: c9fe55012f66e72c
messages.subject: Shiny server working, but not with app requiring very large initial data load from DB
parts:
I have a shiny app. It works fine in the R console. I deployed shiny server, tested the example applications. Works fine.

Now, I deployed my new app into the right folder. First time, the app connects to the DB over a SSH tunnel and grabs a lot of data that takes a while. But, for some reason, I just can get to connect to the app even after a long time. Times out and not work.

Does anyone have ideas on how to handle this scenario? Reading data from DB and storing in CSV first is an option I guess, but I don't like the app to work that way.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server working, but not with app requiring very large initial data load from DB
parts:
Try setting "app_init_timeout" to a large value in your shiny-server.conf file. This might help you if the only issue is the time to read/load the data.

Fereshteh
